name: Wafers
ingredients_raw: Sugar, wheat flour, edible vegetable oil, starch, artificial flavor - strawberry, emulsifier - soy lecithin (e 322), salt, leavening agent - sodium bicarbonate (e500 (ii)], acidity regulator - malic acid (e 296), dough conditioner - sodium metabisulphite (e 223) and artificial color - erythrosine (e 127).
